planting.note: Plant divisions in spring in well-drained soil in full sun; Too Cute is an AHS award-winning daylily cultivar.

directions: Plant divisions in spring in well-drained, fertile soil in full sun. Too Cute, registered in 2012, bearing rose and cream bicolor with a slightly darker eyezone, cream midribs, and a wide cream edge flowers about 2.37 inches across on 32-inch scapes. It received the American Hemerocallis Society's Donn Fischer Memorial Cup for best miniature daylily in 2021, and an Award of Merit in 2023. Divide crowded clumps every three to four years in spring to maintain vigor and bloom count.
